model_output.verdict: An ICU nurse with strong bedside detail and a few questions about charge and committee work.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear story from telemetry at Saguaro Community Hospital to medical ICU care at Desert Valley Medical Center. A recruiter can see your patient load and the care you manage, so I'd expect this to move forward for a Staff Nurse, Medical ICU role with a few questions about your other responsibilities.

The line about caring for 2 critically ill patients per shift in a 24-bed medical ICU works particularly well: it puts your daily assignment in the setting where you do it. Your Arizona RN license and CCRN are also easy to find before the experience section.
Let's start with your charge nurse and precepting work. A little more about what you handle in each would round out the bedside care without taking attention away from it.
